events.title: Dinh Bo Linh ascends the throne as Emperor
events.description: After suppressing the rebellion of the 12 warlords, Dinh Bo Linh ascended the throne as Emperor (Dinh Tien Hoang), named the country Dai Co Viet, and chose Hoa Lu as the capital. This was the first centralized feudal state of Vietnam.

events.title: Victory over the Song Army (1st Time)
events.description: At the Hoa Lu imperial citadel and surrounding areas, Le Hoan (Le Dai Hanh) commanded the military and people of Dai Co Viet to defeat the invading Song army on the Bach Dang River and at Chi Lang Pass, firmly protecting national independence.

events.title: Moving the capital from Hoa Lu to Thang Long
events.description: King Ly Thai To issued the Edict on the Transfer of the Capital. The King's dragon boat fleet departed from Ghenh Thap wharf (Hoa Lu), traveling up the Day River to the Red River to reach Dai La, ending Hoa Lu's 42-year role as the nation's capital.

events.title: Construction of Vu Lam Royal Palace
events.description: The Tran kings built the Vu Lam base in the rugged mountainous region of Ninh Binh. This place became a strategic rear area during the second and third resistance wars against the Mongol invaders, and was also where King Tran Nhan Tong entered monastic life.
tags: Resistance war against the Mongol invaders

events.title: Construction of the Tam Diep - Bien Son defense line
events.description: Faced with the strength of the Qing army, Ngo Thi Nham advocated withdrawing troops to Tam Diep 'to let the enemy stay overnight'. Here, Nguyen Hue joined forces with Ngo Thi Nham, treated the troops to an early Tet celebration, and launched a lightning march to defeat the Qing army.

events.title: Establishment of Kim Son District
events.description: Land reclamation envoy Nguyen Cong Tru recruited people to build dikes, reclaim land from the sea, and cultivate the coastal alluvial plains of Ninh Binh, officially establishing Kim Son District (meaning 'Golden Mountain').

events.title: Establishment of the first Party Cell
events.description: In Lu Phong village, the first Indochinese Communist Party cell of Ninh Binh Province was established with 4 members, with Comrade Luong Van Thang as Secretary, marking a turning point in the province's revolutionary movement.

events.title: Seizing power in Ninh Binh Province
events.description: Under the leadership of the Uprising Committee, the masses seized the Governor's Palace and the Civil Guard Camp. The Governor of Ninh Binh surrendered and handed over the official seals. The Provisional Revolutionary People's Committee of the province was introduced to the public.

events.title: Ha Nam Ninh Campaign (Quang Trung Campaign)
events.description: General Vo Nguyen Giap launched a major campaign attacking the French defense line along the Day River. The opening battle to destroy the Non Nuoc position (Ninh Binh) was fierce, where squad leader Hoang Sam and political officer Ky Van heroically sacrificed their lives.

events.title: Liberation of Ninh Binh Town
events.description: Faced with pressure from the Vietnamese army and defeat on the Indochina battlefield, French troops withdrew from Ninh Binh Town. Our soldiers entered to take over, and Ninh Binh Province was completely liberated.

events.title: Re-establishment of Ninh Binh Province
events.description: Implementing the Resolution of the 8th National Assembly on the division of Ha Nam Ninh Province, Ninh Binh Province was re-established and officially went into operation, opening up a period of socio-economic and tourism development.
